description: This file defines functions related to retrieving feature descriptions, filtering features based on subscription, and finding native features by identifier within the Features module.

methods.name: export function GetFeatures(): FeatureDescription[] { GetFeatures
methods.description: Returns an array of all available feature descriptions by aggregating server, client, experimental, and deprecated features.

methods.name: export function GetFeaturesForSubscription(subscription: SubscriptionName): FeatureDescription[]/ GetFeaturesForSubscription
methods.description: Filters and returns features available within a specific subscription based on the subscription name.

methods.name: export function FindNativeFeature(identifier: FeatureIdentifier): FeatureDescription | undefined/ FindNativeFeature
methods.description: Finds and returns a native feature by its unique identifier.
